_comment: Parity vectors for the instant tier (__tests__/instantTier.parity.test.ts). `pythonScore` is the openSMILE eGeMAPS reference model's P(angry) for the clip's loudest 2 s window; `tsFeatures` is what apps/mobile/src/live/instantTier.ts measured on exactly those samples. The bar is RANK agreement, not numeric equality — different windows, filterbank and pitch tracker. Clips carrying `pcmBase64` hold that 2 s window as little-endian int16 at 16 kHz so the extractor can be re-run end to end; the rest carry features only, because audio does not belong in git. Regenerate: python scripts/instant_tier_select.py fixture.
